$comment: `make example-deploy EXAMPLE=flaky` ships a healthy release (HEALTHY=1).
`make example-break` then ships the same script without it, so the process
starts, systemd reports the unit active, and the health check never passes —
at which point nudo puts the previous release back.
Retries are low so the failure arrives quickly.
name: flaky
description: Starts fine, never becomes ready — for watching a rollback
